title: Verdacht der Beihilfe zum Computerbetrug – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors executed search warrants and arrest warrants in Germany, Serbia and North Rhine-Westphalia against suspects accused of aiding computer fraud via a spoofed-number VoIP service. Domains, servers and Telegram accounts of the criminal platform were seized and shut down.
